days.title: The Odle Group and High Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Alta via n. 2
stops.detail: The park is crossed from north to south by the Alta via n. 2.

stops.name: via delle Odle
stops.detail: The group is a destination for many hikers and climbers because it offers everything from via ferratas to climbs of modest, medium, and extreme difficulty, as well as hiking walks of particular interest, such as the "via delle Odle" (in German Adolf Munekl-Weg), the path that passes the northern base of the Odle group.

stops.name: Piz de Puez
stops.detail: To the southeast lies the Puez group, in turn divided with the Stevìa group, the Sassongher and Gran Cir-Vallunga subgroups, where the highest peak is Piz de Puez (2,913 m).

stops.name: Vallunga
stops.detail: The sparse woodland of Vallunga, consisting of spruce, larch, and stone pine, is also remarkable.
